brief: A deep indigo solid background remains static while a continuous medical waveform traces horizontally across it. The white waveform pulses rhythmically, shifting its color to match the hue of its own tracing stroke against the unchanging backdrop. This cyclical energy transfer mimics glacial rock layers forming and relaxing in sequence, observed through a searching slime mould effect.
